title: Cardinal DriveSense Training Note — Discount Start Points, Retention and Term Rescoring
content:
Four program settings of Cardinal DriveSense govern the timing and life of a vehicle's DriveSense discount. They are set per program as follows.

| Program | Participation discount starts to apply | Earned discount starts to apply | Fixed earned discount kept after opting out | Driving keeps being scored and the discount is reset every term |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Cardinal DriveSense Mobile | Next renewal term, or new business | Next renewal term | Yes | No |
| Cardinal DriveSense Plug-In | Next renewal term, or new business | Next renewal term | Yes | No |
| Cardinal DriveSense Connected Car | Next renewal term, or new business | Next renewal term | Yes | No |
| Cardinal DriveSense Teen Coach | Next renewal term, or new business | Next renewal term | No | Yes |
| Cardinal DriveSense Miles Mobile | Not applicable | Not applicable | No | No |
| Cardinal DriveSense Miles Plug-In | Not applicable | Not applicable | No | No |

## Questions answered by the table

**From when does the participation discount apply on a safe-driving or teen program?**
From the next renewal term, or with new business. The setting is the same on Mobile, Plug-In, Connected Car and Teen Coach.

**From when does an earned discount apply?**
From the next renewal term, on Mobile, Plug-In, Connected Car and Teen Coach.

**Do the two pay-per-mile programs have either start point?**
No. On Cardinal DriveSense Miles Mobile and Cardinal DriveSense Miles Plug-In both settings read "not applicable".

**On which programs is a fixed earned discount kept after the customer opts out?**
Mobile, Plug-In and Connected Car. The setting reads "No" on Teen Coach and on both pay-per-mile programs.

**On which program is driving rescored and the discount reset each term?**
Teen Coach only. On every other program the setting reads "No".

## Program comparison (hypothetical vehicles)

- A vehicle on Cardinal DriveSense Connected Car and a vehicle on Cardinal DriveSense Teen Coach share both start points (next renewal term; participation discount at the next renewal term or new business), but differ on the last two columns: Connected Car keeps a fixed earned discount after an opt-out and is not reset each term; Teen Coach is the reverse on both.
